status: starting values per master plan §4.2 — frozen here for P1; to be tuned once against the full 60 labelled declarations at IC-1 (2026-10-17), then frozen again under a new rules id if changed
nos_coverage_formula: coverage(NOS) = sum(effective_claim(pc) for pc in linked_pcs(NOS)) / count(linked_pcs(NOS)), where effective_claim(pc) = max over links touching pc of (answer_strength(card_or_tool_answer) x link.weight), clamped to [0,1]. PCs with no card/tool link (see links.json.known_gaps) are excluded from both sides of this ratio.
overall_coverage_formula: overall = sum(coverage(nos) x credits(nos) for nos in practical_nos_for_matching) / sum(credits(nos) for nos in practical_nos_for_matching)
experience_rule: A practical NOS counts as 'has declared experience' only if at least one card/tool linked to one of its PCs was answered 'sometimes' or 'often' (i.e. effective_claim > 0 for at least one linked PC).

match_result_rules.label: Appropriate match
match_result_rules.condition: overall >= 0.60 AND every NOS in practical_nos_for_matching has declared experience

match_result_rules.label: Partial match — gaps
match_result_rules.condition: 0.35 <= overall < 0.60, OR (overall >= 0.60 AND one or more practical NOS has no declared experience). Assessment can still proceed; gaps are shown to worker and assessor.

match_result_rules.label: Not an appropriate match
match_result_rules.condition: overall < 0.35. Worker is told plainly; the assessor can still choose to open an assessment.

output_contract.because: list of short human-readable reasons naming the cards/tools and NOS that drove the result
output_contract.gap_nos: list of NOS codes below their own appropriate-match bar or with no declared experience
output_contract.applicable_tasks: T1-T5 always listed; tasks whose NOS is in gap_nos are marked extra_evidence_needed=true

never_decides_competence: This matcher only explains how a self-declaration relates to CON/Q0602 v4.0 and which tasks need the most evidence. It never outputs pass/fail or a PC score — only a human assessor scores competence (see rubric.json).
